title.en: Ethiopia's election results will likely confirm status quo
title.zh: 埃塞俄比亚选举结果或将确认现状

summary.en: Ethiopia's ruling Prosperity Party is expected to secure a decisive victory in the recent election. The electoral process was characterized by security concerns, a fragmented opposition, and the inability of some regions to participate in voting.
summary.zh: 埃塞俄比亚执政的繁荣党预计将在最近的选举中获得决定性胜利。此次选举的特点是安全挑战、反对派分裂以及部分地区被排除在投票之外。

body.en:
Ethiopia's ruling Prosperity Party is set for a decisive election win when results are announced. The election was marked by security challenges, a divided opposition and the exclusion of entire regions from voting.

The June 1 parliamentary election in  Ethiopia  has been described as a success despite the exclusion of parts of the country for what officials said were security reasons.

Nearly 50 million people registered to vote in the election in Ethiopia, Africa's second-most-populous country. However, citing insecurity, officials suspended voting in at least 140 constituencies in two of the most populous regions: Amhara and Oromia.

Voting was also suspended in Tigray , the fourth-most-populous region, with election organizers citing "unfavorable conditions."

Despite the suspension of votes in some areas, a joint statement by the AU Election Observation Mission and  Intergovernmental Authority on Development (IGAD) described the election as peaceful.

"The IGAD mission further extends its sincere congratulations to the government and the people of Ethiopia for the generally peaceful and orderly conduct of the electoral process," said Speciosa Wandira-Kazibwe, Uganda's former vice president and head of the IGAD Observer Mission.

Wandira-Kazibwe said the peaceful conduct of the polls puts Ethiopia on a path toward "stability, constitutionalism and democratic progress."

There were mixed reactions among political parties to the outcomes on Election Day.

The Ethiopian Citizens for Social Justice, which is based in the South Ethiopia regional state, said "overall, the situation was positive, with no major problems reported."

But the Coalition for Ethiopian Unity and the Kucha People's Democratic Party   submitted a complaint to the National Election Board of Ethiopia, alleging disenfranchisement among some of its members.

"Our constituency were unable to exercise their constitutional right to elect their own representatives," Bandira Belachew of the Kucha People's Democratic Party told reporters.

The party has requested an annulment of the election in the Kucha constituency based on the claims.

Although election results are not expected until 10 days after voting, many observers and analysts predict a landslide victory for Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed's ruling Prosperity Party.

The Prosperity Party currently holds 457 out of 547 seats in the House of Representatives and is expected to maintain its hold on power.

"We have very fragmented, weak opposition parties that could not pose serious threat to the ruling party," said analyst Bizuneh Yimenu of Queen's University in Belfast. He told DW that power imbalances between the Prosperity Party and opposition...
body.zh: 选举结果公布后，埃塞俄比亚执政党繁荣党有望取得决定性胜利。这次选举的特点是安全挑战、反对派分裂以及整个地区被排除在投票之外。 埃塞俄比亚 6 月 1 日的议会选举被认为是成功的，尽管官员们称出于安全原因该国部分地区被排除在外。 非洲第二人口大国埃塞俄比亚有近5000万人登记投票。然而，以不安全为由，官员们暂停了人口最多的两个地区阿姆哈拉州和奥罗米亚州至少 140 个选区的投票。 人口第四大地区提格雷的投票也被暂停，选举组织者称“条件不利”。 尽管某些地区暂停投票，但非盟选举观察团和政府间发展管理局 (IGAD) 的联合声明称选举是和平的。 乌干达前副总统兼伊加特观察团团长斯佩西奥萨·万迪拉-卡齐布韦表示：“伊加特代表团进一步向埃塞俄比亚政府和人民表示诚挚祝贺，祝贺选举进程总体和平有序地进行。” 万迪拉-卡齐布韦表示，和平进行的投票使埃塞俄比亚走上了“稳定、宪政和民主进步”的道路。 各政党对选举日的结果反应不一。 总部位于埃塞俄比亚南部地区的埃塞俄比亚公民社会正义组织表示，“总体而言，情况是积极的，没有报告重大问题。” 但埃塞俄比亚团结联盟和库车人民民主党向埃塞俄比亚国家选举委员会提交了一份申诉，声称其一些成员被剥夺了选举权。 “我们的选区无法行使其宪法权利来选举自己的代表，”库车人民民主党的班迪拉·贝拉丘 (Bandira Belachew) 告诉记者。 根据这些说法，该党已要求废除库车选区的选举。 尽管选举结果要到投票后 10 天才能公布，但许多观察家和分析人士预测，总理阿比·艾哈迈德领导的执政党繁荣党将取得压倒性胜利。 繁荣党目前在众议院 547 个席位中拥有 457 个席位，预计将继续执政。 贝尔法斯特女王大学的分析师比祖内·伊梅努 (Bizuneh Yimenu) 表示：“我们的反对党非常分散、实力薄弱，无法对执政党构成严重威胁。”他告诉德国之声，繁荣党和反对派之间的权力不平衡......

reflection.en: Elections are meant to reflect the will of the people, and when they are marred by exclusion and division, the hope for true representation can diminish. Proverbs reminds us that the nature of leadership profoundly impacts the well-being of a nation, with righteous rule bringing joy and unrighteous rule leading to distress. As results confirm the status...
reflection.zh: 选举旨在反映民意，但当选举因排斥和分裂而受损时，对真正代表性的希望可能会减弱。箴言提醒我们，领导的性质深刻影响着国家的福祉，公义的统治带来喜乐，不义的统治则导致痛苦。随着结果确认现状，许多人将关注政府是否真正服务于所有公民。

verse.textEn: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; when the wicked rule, the people groan.
verse.textZh: 义人增多，民就喜乐；恶人掌权，民就叹息。

title.en: PM backs upping the volume at Sydney Opera House - ‘I’m a member of the fun faction’ – as it happened
title.zh: 澳大利亚人个人贷款借贷额创历史新高

summary.en: Australians are taking on record amounts of personal loans as increasing living costs deplete their savings. This trend indicates growing financial strain on households.
summary.zh: 随着生活成本的不断上涨，澳大利亚人的储蓄缓冲被耗尽，他们正在以创纪录的金额借贷个人贷款。

body.en:
The prime minister, Anthony Albanese , has supported the NSW government’s plan to extend hours, audience capacity and volume allowance for outdoor performances at the Opera House.

As we reported earlier, the state government will increase the maximum capacity for outdoor events from 5,000 to 6,000 people for low- and medium-scale events, and from 6,000 to 7,000 for major events, as part of changes to the Sydney Opera House.

The late-night sound levels for major events will be raised to match the maximum levels allowed earlier in the day, and event hours will be extended across all days of the week.

The Opera House previously copped a $15,000 fine after residents complained about the volume of a Florence + the Machine performance in 2015.

Albanese said he had seen the English band on the forecourt, along with American rockers the Pixies.

We should be using it, and it should be bringing in economic activity as well as joy to those people who get to go to the concert or the play or whatever other activity is taking place.
body.zh: 总理安东尼·艾博尼斯 (Anthony Albanese) 支持新南威尔士州政府延长歌剧院户外表演时间、观众容量和音量限额的计划。 正如我们之前报道的，作为悉尼歌剧院改造的一部分，州政府将把中小型活动的户外活动最大容量从 5,000 人增加到 6,000 人，大型活动的最大容量从 6,000 人增加到 7,000 人。 大型活动的深夜噪音水平将提高到当天早些时候允许的最高水平，并且活动时间将延长到一周中的所有日子。 2015 年，因居民抱怨 Florence + the Machine 演出的音量，歌剧院曾被处以 15,000 美元的罚款。 阿尔巴尼斯说，他在前院看到了英国乐队，还有美国摇滚乐队小精灵乐队。 我们应该使用它，它应该为那些参加音乐会、戏剧或任何其他活动的人们带来经济活动和欢乐。

reflection.en: The news of Australians taking on record personal loans highlights the financial pressures many face as living costs rise and savings dwindle. Proverbs 22:7 reminds us of the vulnerability that comes with debt, noting that "the borrower is slave to the lender." In challenging economic times, this verse calls us to consider the weight of financial burdens...
reflection.zh: 澳大利亚人因生活成本上涨和储蓄耗尽而大量借贷个人贷款，这凸显了许多人面临的经济压力。箴言22:7提醒我们债务带来的脆弱性，指出“欠债的是债主的仆人”。在充满挑战的经济时期，这节经文呼吁我们思考财务负担的重压，并寻求智慧来管理我们的资源。

verse.textEn: The rich rule over the poor, and the borrower is slave to the lender.
verse.textZh: 富户管辖穷人；欠债的是债主的仆人。

title.en: ‘Poisoned’ AI: the ChatGPT shopping scams that lead to fake websites
title.zh: AI“投毒”：ChatGPT购物诈骗导致虚假网站

summary.en: Buyers are being defrauded after trusting online stores recommended by AI tools, assuming they were genuine. These scams lead consumers to fake websites, resulting in financial loss.
summary.zh: 消费者因信任人工智能工具推荐的网店而上当受骗，误以为这些网店是正品。这些诈骗将消费者引向虚假网站，导致经济损失。

body.en: Buyers are ripped off after assuming online stores were genuine because they are recommended by an AI tool You want to buy a new bag and so you ask ChatGPT for help. You have always liked Russell & Bromley so you ask ChatGPT what is popular there at the moment. The artificial intelligence (AI) assistant gives you cross body, shoulder, casual and formal options with the prices listed beside them. You click through from the sources to what looks like the official Russell & Bromley site and buy your new bag, which is conveniently on sale. Continue reading...
body.zh: 买家因为人工智能工具推荐而认为网上商店是正品，结果被骗了。你想买一个新包，所以你向 ChatGPT 寻求帮助。您一直很喜欢 Russell & Bromley，所以您询问 ChatGPT 目前那里流行什么。人工智能 (AI) 助手为您提供斜挎、肩背、休闲和正装选择，并在旁边列出价格。您从来源中点击进入看起来像是 Russell & Bromley 官方网站的网站，然后购买您的新包，该包很方便地打折。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In an age where information is abundant and often generated by AI, discernment is more crucial than ever. This incident reminds us that we must not blindly trust every recommendation, but rather carefully consider our steps and verify sources. Prudence helps us navigate a complex digital world, protecting us from deception.
reflection.zh: 在信息泛滥且常由人工智能生成的时代，辨别力比以往任何时候都更加重要。这起事件提醒我们，不能盲目相信每一个推荐，而应仔细思量我们的脚步并核实信息来源。谨慎能帮助我们驾驭复杂的数字世界，保护我们免受欺骗。

verse.textEn: The simple believe anything, but the prudent give thought to their steps.
verse.textZh: 愚蒙人是话都信；通达人步步谨慎。

body.en: Research shows generations of children in England will grow up homeless unless government addresses council housing debt, charity says It would take more than a century to clear the social housing waiting lists in England at the government’s current speed of delivering new social homes, research by Shelter has shown. The housing charity found that more than 1.3m households are on a waiting list for a social home, but only 12,198 were built by councils, housing associations or private developers across England last year. This equates to an average of 110 households waiting for every new social home delivered, and it would take 119 years to clear the waiting lists if building continued at the same rate. title.en: Car industry pressing EU for further delay to Brexit EV tariffs
title.zh: 汽车行业敦促欧盟进一步推迟脱欧电动汽车关税

summary.en: The EU and UK car industries are requesting the European Commission to delay, for a second time, the implementation of Brexit trade deal tariffs on electric vehicle imports. The original 2020 agreement aimed to boost local battery production, but the industry states it cannot yet meet the set targets.

body.en: Exclusive: deal in 2020 had sought to stimulate local battery making but industry says it still cannot meet targets The EU and UK car industries are urging the European Commission to adjust the Brexit trade deal and suspend, for a second time, tariffs on imports of electric vehicles. They have expressed concerns that they will not be able to meet the conditions set for 1 January 2027 for tariff-free sales. This is because of strict rules of origin over what products can qualify for tariff-free trade under the EU-UK Trade and Cooperation Agreement which has applied since 2021. Continue reading...
body.zh: 独家：2020年协议试图刺激当地电池生产，但业界表示仍无法实现目标欧盟和英国汽车行业正在敦促欧盟委员会调整英国脱欧贸易协议，并第二次暂停对电动汽车进口征收关税。他们担心无法满足 2027 年 1 月 1 日起的免税销售条件。这是因为自 2021 年起适用的欧盟-英国贸易与合作协定对哪些产品有资格享受免关税贸易有严格的原产地规则。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The car industry's plea for a tariff delay highlights the intricate balance between ambitious policy goals and practical industrial realities. This situation reminds us that even well-intentioned plans require continuous wise counsel and flexibility to adapt when initial targets prove challenging to meet.
reflection.zh: 汽车行业请求推迟关税的呼吁，凸显了雄心勃勃的政策目标与实际工业现实之间错综复杂的平衡。这提醒我们，即使是善意的计划，也需要持续的明智建议和灵活性，以便在最初的目标难以实现时进行调整。

title.en: Hegseth attacks Europe over migration with beach 'invasion' D-Day speech
title.zh: 赫格塞特在D日讲话中抨击欧洲移民“入侵”其海滩

summary.en: The US defence secretary, speaking in Normandy on the 82nd anniversary of D-Day, criticized Europe's approach to migration, describing the arrival of migrants on its beaches as an 'invasion'.
summary.zh: 美国国防部长在诺曼底发表D日登陆82周年纪念讲话时，批评欧洲处理移民问题的方式，将移民抵达欧洲海滩描述为一场“入侵”。

body.en:
US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth has criticised European nations over migration for allowing what he described as an "invasion" on their shores, during a D-Day anniversary speech in France.

Hegseth was speaking in Normandy 82 years after allied forces stormed French beaches to liberate Nazi-occupied Europe in 1944.

"Sadly, today, different European beaches are stormed by different dangerous ideologies," Hegseth said. "Beaches in Spain, in Italy, in Greece and Bulgaria. Boats and men arrive. When will European capitals do something about that invasion?"

Migration has become a major political issue across Europe, with parties supporting hardline immigration policies surging in polls.

The Trump administration sees an immigration crackdown as a key part of its domestic policy agenda, requesting billions more in funding for enforcement agencies.

Hegseth's comments mark a further criticism of European migration policy by senior members of the Trump administration.

On Friday, US Vice-President JD Vance blamed the death of the 18-year-old British student Henry Nowak, who was fatally stabbed last year in Southampton by Vickrum Digwa, on the "mass invasion of migrants" and said the "only response" was "righteous anger".

Downing Street responded by criticising "people trying to interfere in our democracy ," adding that the Nowak family had "said they do not want his death to be used to create further division".

Speaking in France, Hegseth said that in the years since D-Day some European capitals have grown too "comfortable" with their hard-fought freedoms, forgetting that "freedom is not free".

"The men who fought and died here restored freedom to Europe," Hegseth said. "That freedom must be maintained by this generation of leaders and war fighters or what they fought for was merely temporary."

D-Day was the largest seaborne military operation ever attempted and involved the simultaneous landing of tens of thousands of troops from the UK, US and Canada on five separate beaches in Normandy in northern France.

US President Donald Trump has also criticised European immigration policy, telling the UN last year that European countries were "going to hell" due to "uncontrolled migration".

In response, UK Prime Minister Sir Keir Starmer said the president's remarks were "not right", while accepting the "challenge" of tackling illegal migration, particularly from people crossing the English Channel in small boats.

Sea arrivals into mainland Europe peaked in 2015, when the UN said more than a million people crossed the Mediterranean. title.en: Armenia votes as Russia piles pressure on pro-West government
title.zh: 俄罗斯向亲西方政府施压，亚美尼亚投票

summary.en: Incumbent Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan is seeking a third term despite falling domestic support.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Voting is under way in Armenia in an election which could decide whether the country continues edging towards the West, or returns to its traditional ally Russia.

The small South Caucausus country of three million people has been under mounting economic pressure from Moscow, as Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan seeks re-election on a promise of European integration.

The election has drawn significant international attention to Armenia, which has steadily grown closer to the West while still intertwined with Russia, its largest trading partner.

Since coming to power in 2018, the prime minister has steered his country away from Moscow, passed a law to launch the process of joining the EU, and accelerated the peace process with neighbouring Azerbaijan via a US-brokered agreement. The latter has won him US President Donald Trump's endorsement.

Pashinyan also hosted a large summit of EU leaders and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky in the capital, Yerevan, earlier this year.

Yet despite these successes, Pashinyan's domestic support has fallen from 54% in 2021 to around 30% today.

The main reason is Nagorno-Karabakh, a mountainous enclave inside Azerbaijan that was home to 100,000 ethnic Armenians until Azerbaijan took it by force in 2023.

Pashinyan's critics have never forgiven him for making concessions in favour of peace with Azerbaijan, like refusing to campaign for the release of former leaders of Nagorno-Karabakh who are in jail in the neighbouring country.

The peace deal with Azerbaijan, too, remains deeply divisive, with one recent poll showing 44% of public opinion in support and 41% opposed.

Pashinyan's critics now form several opposition parties and alliances. One of the main ones is the Armenia Alliance, led by former president Robert Kocharyan. Former president Serzh Sargsyan's Republican Party is not fielding candidates but has urged its supporters to vote against the incumbent.

Both ex-leaders argue that restoring deep military and economic ties with Russia is Armenia's only path to national security.

And Pashinyan's main challenger is billionaire Samvel Karapetyan, who made his fortune in Russia. He is under house arrest - accused of plotting to overthrow the government - and is conducting the campaign through his nephew.

The latest International Republican Institute poll shows Pashinyan's Civil Contract leading with 32%, while around 40% of voters say they trust no political figure.

If the opposition candidates worked together, they could match Pashinyan's vote, but divided they cannot beat him.

Last month, Vladimir Putin listed the economic benefits Armenia stood to lose if it pursued closer ties with the West, and pointedly noted that "the crisis in Ukraine began with efforts to move toward EU accession".

body.en:
A seven-month-old Palestinian baby has been shot dead and his parents injured after Israeli troops fired on their car in the occupied West Bank, the Palestinian health ministry has said.

The Israeli military said that soldiers shot at a vehicle perceived to be accelerating toward them near Hebron. It said an initial inquiry found that the three Palestinians wounded were uninvolved civilians.

Israeli military activity and settler violence against Palestinians have surged in the territory since the war in Gaza began in October 2023.

The baby's father, Bethlehem University lecturer Fahd Abu Haikal, told The Associated Press that a bullet struck the windshield before piercing his right hand and striking his son and wife in the back seat Friday evening. Another bullet struck the hood, according to AP journalists who saw the car.

"He was the entire world," Haikal said of the boy, who turned seven months on Friday.

The baby's body was wrapped in a Palestinian flag. His father carried him. The men placed the small bundle at their feet and bowed in prayer.

She said that they were driving near a checkpoint and stopped when they saw Israeli military vehicles and soldiers in the distance. She said she initially thought the gunfire was warning shots.

"The scene was horrific to see a 7-month-old baby with a smashed face," she said.

Israeli soldiers accused of harming Palestinians are seldom penalised, and were indicted in fewer than 1 per cent of cases based on 2,427 complaints alleging wrongdoing between 2016 and 2024, according to Israeli rights group Yesh Din.

On Saturday, the Palestinian Red Crescent said that eight people were wounded in settler attacks on the town of Huwara, near Nablus, including from tear gas inhalation and rubber-coated metal bullets.

Israel's military said that riots broke out between Israelis and Palestinians, with rocks and batons, after a reported theft of livestock and soldiers dispersed them.

The military said that it was aware of footage showing a soldier using violence against a Palestinian and it was under review. Images appeared to show someone being thrown to the ground and beaten.

Huwara has seen numerous attacks in recent years. In February 2023, scores of Israeli settlers rampaged there, burning dozens of cars and homes, after a Palestinian gunman killed two settlers.

The United Nations said last month that more than 1,000 Palestinians, including at least 240 children, have been killed in the West Bank and east Jerusalem since the war in Gaza began with the attack by Hamas-led militants on southern Israel on 7 October 2023.

title.en: Manhunt underway after 12 injured in shooting at street festival in US state of Ohio
title.zh: 美国俄亥俄州街头节庆活动发生枪击事件，12人受伤，警方正在搜捕嫌犯

summary.en: The shooting took place in Toledo on Saturday afternoon local time, with police saying several people had been injured.
summary.zh: 当地时间周六下午，俄亥俄州托莱多市发生枪击事件，警方称多人受伤。

body.en:
Gunfire erupted near a busy street festival in the US state of Ohio, wounding at least 12 people and sending some event-goers scrambling for cover while others rushed to help the victims.

The shooting was in the city of Toledo, with police responding after reports of a person shot near the Old West End Festival about 5.30pm on Saturday, local time (7.30am Sunday AEST).

No suspects were in custody hours afterwards, Toledo deputy police chief Joe Heffernan said, and officials urged people who were at the festival to come forward with any photos or videos on their phones for possible leads.

The shooting happened near the Old West End Festival, an annual gathering of live music and home tours.

Heffernan said it appeared that at least two people fired weapons and they were "probably shooting at each other".

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The ages of the victims ranged from 14 to 61, with most of them in their early 20s.

"I am deeply concerned about the situation in Toledo tonight,” Ohio governor Mike DeWine said in a statement.

"Summer festivals should be safe spaces for families to spend time together without fear of violence."

Multiple videos posted to social media showed people running amid the sound of gunshots and emergency officials tending to others who appeared wounded.

Fire chief Allison Armstrong said it was difficult to get to the hospital due to closed roads and traffic from people leaving the festival, but emergency responders were able to transport all patients from the scene within an hour.

Kevin Berry was sitting in the neighbourhood arboretum listening to live music with friends when he heard a handful of gunshots ring out.

When Berry looked back up, he saw a gun being tossed to the ground less than 15 meyres away from him. Officers who were already on site for the festival responded immediately.

Berry, who has medical training and served in the Navy, walked around looking for anyone who might need help and saw at least five people with gunshot wounds.

The Old West End Festival is a two-day celebration in Toledo’s historic district that includes live music, food vendors, home tours and shopping.

George Kral, safety director for the city, said officials were discussing with organisers whether it would continue through the weekend.

"This is one of the most iconic festivals in Toledo," he said, "and it’s a shame that something like this had to ruin it".

After Sean Reifel was announced as a cast member of the dating show last week, the mayor of the city of 75,000 residents expressed frustration over his departure - less than a year after he'd joined the department.

"I never thought I'd see the day in America where reality show participation wins out over being a police officer," Mayor J. William Reynolds said.

"Our police department spent a lot of time training and we paid thousands of taxpayer dollars to send him to the police academy," the mayor said, according to Fox8 .

Reifel's former boss, Police Chief Michelle Kott, told the BBC that while the department respects his decision, "I would be less than candid if I didn't acknowledge my disappointment in losing another police officer".

Kott said that with Reifel's resignation, the department now has 16 officer vacancies. He has noted Reifel's decision was not a good look.

"Law enforcement agencies across the United States continue to face significant recruiting and retention challenges, and every vacancy affects our organization and the community we serve," the police chief added.

The drama caused a stir among residents in the area known for its lush greenery, colonial architecture and industrial history.

Kristine Ruff, a small business owner who lives in the area, was getting her hair done at a local salon.

Ruff recounted the salon owner saying, "Oh my God, did you hear? One of the contestants is from Bethlehem. He's a cop. I was like, 'Oh my God, that's crazy.'"

Ruff, whose kids go to school in Bethlehem, told the BBC she immediately texted her sister, who said: "Yeah, we were just talking about it.'"

Everyone in the area is "sending the show clips from Instagram to each other, saying, like, 'Can you believe that it's a local guy that's on the show?'" Ruff said.

But the controversy with local officials has seeped into the excitement. Ruff said she's watching the show this season as Bethlehem is thrust into the national spotlight.

Residents in one community Facebook group appeared divided over the evolving saga.

title.en: 'It was either killed or be killed' - ongoing nightmares of an ex-child soldier in Somalia
title.zh: “要么杀人，要么被杀”——索马里前儿童兵挥之不去的噩梦

summary.en: Yusuf Ali, now 34, struggles with his memories living in Mogadishu surrounded by dark reminders of his past.
summary.zh: 34岁的优素福·阿里曾是索马里的一名儿童兵，如今在摩加迪沙生活，却被过去黑暗的记忆和周围的提醒所困扰，持续遭受噩梦的折磨。

body.en:
Shopkeeper Yusuf Ali still battles with memories of his time as a child soldier fighting on the streets of Somalia's capital, Mogadishu.

The 34-year-old became embroiled in the Islamist insurgency, which erupted nearly 20 years ago, and while the city's urban landscape is healing, few resources are devoted to those still suffering with the psychological scars of the conflict.

When he was 14 years old, a coalition of Sharia courts seized power in Somalia and provided some sense of stability in a country that had been riven by devastating clan warfare since the regime of President Siad Barre collapsed in 1991.

But the Union of Islamic Courts (UIC) marked the first instance of political Islam gaining a foothold in the African continent since al-Qaeda's 11 September 2001 attacks on the US.

Policymakers in Washington viewed the UIC with hostility, accusing it of having ties to al-Qaeda. Its military youth wing was known as al-Shabab, meaning "The Lads".

In December 2006, thousands of Ethiopian troops invaded Somalia under the cover of American drones with the aim of toppling the courts just six months after they had taken over.

Ethiopia's invasion was deeply unpopular in Somalia and was met with fierce opposition as al-Shabab and its allies, including a coalition of splinter groups known as the Muqawama, meaning "Resistance", clubbed together to fight it.

At the time Ali lived in Huriwaa, an impoverished district in the north of Mogadishu.

Aged one, he had lost his father - killed while taking part in what has been dubbed the "Battle of Mogadishu", when Somali fighters infamously clashed with US soldiers after the downing of two American Black Hawk helicopters .

It was hard growing up without his dad, but it was the guerrilla warfare that overtook Mogadishu during the Ethiopian invasion that changed him forever.

"At night, I'd often hear a buzzing sound. I was in secondary school and didn't realise it then, but these were planes surveilling our neighbourhood," Ali tells the BBC.

By the spring of 2007, fighting intensified with heavy shelling and bombardment of densely populated civilian neighbourhoods suspected of sheltering insurgents.

"On one of the nights, a large barrage of shells hit our area and some of them struck our neighbour's house. Our house shook and I felt like the soil under my feet had moved - then I started hearing screams," Ali recalls.

Frantic residents struggled to lift the rubble and that was when he saw a lifeless body.

"Someone aimed a torch and I saw blood stains and a body lying nearby. A young girl that looked around my age, but she wasn't moving. I've seen death, but nothing prepared me for that night."

body.zh: 店主优素福·阿里至今仍无法忘怀自己作为儿童兵在索马里首都摩加迪沙街头打架的经历。 这位 34 岁的男子卷入了近 20 年前爆发的伊斯兰叛乱，尽管这座城市的城市景观正在愈合，但很少有资源投入到那些仍然遭受冲突心理创伤的人们身上。 当他 14 岁时，伊斯兰教法院联盟在索马里夺取了权力，并为这个自 1991 年西亚德·巴雷总统政权倒台以来一直因毁灭性部族战争而四分五裂的国家带来了一定的稳定感。 但伊斯兰法院联盟 (UIC) 标志着自基地组织 2001 年 9 月 11 日袭击美国以来，政治伊斯兰首次在非洲大陆站稳脚跟。 华盛顿的政策制定者对 UIC 充满敌意，指责其与基地组织有联系。其军事青年翼被称为“青年党”，意思是“小伙子”。 2006年12月，数千名埃塞俄比亚军队在美国无人机的掩护下入侵索马里，目的是在他们接管索马里六个月后推翻法院。 埃塞俄比亚的入侵在索马里极不受欢迎，并遭到了青年党及其盟友的强烈反对，因为青年党及其盟友，包括被称为“穆卡瓦马”（意为“抵抗”）的分裂组织联盟，联合起来进行打击。 当时阿里住在摩加迪沙北部的贫困地区胡里瓦。 他一岁时就失去了父亲，他在参加被称为“摩加迪沙之战”的战斗时丧生，当时索马里武装分子在两架美国黑鹰直升机被击落后与美国士兵发生了臭名昭著的冲突。 没有父亲，他的成长过程很艰难，但埃塞俄比亚入侵期间席卷摩加迪沙的游击战永远改变了他。 “晚上，我经常听到嗡嗡声。我当时正在上中学，当时没有意识到，但这些飞机正在监视我们的社区，”阿里告诉 BBC。 到 2007 年春天，战斗愈演愈烈，对涉嫌庇护叛乱分子的人口稠密的平民社区进行了猛烈炮击和轰炸。 “有一天晚上，一大批炮弹袭击了我们的地区，其中一些击中了邻居的房子。我们的房子摇晃起来，我感觉脚下的土壤移动了 - 然后我开始听到尖叫声，”阿里回忆道。 疯狂的居民奋力抬起废墟，就在这时，他看到了一具毫无生气的尸体。 “有人用手电筒瞄准，我看到血迹和附近躺着一具尸体。一个看起来和我年龄相仿的年轻女孩，但她一动不动。我见过死亡，但那天晚上我没有任何准备。” 这家人逃到摩加迪沙西北部的埃拉沙比亚哈区，该地区已成为数百人的避难所......

reflection.en: The haunting memories and ongoing nightmares of a former child soldier reveal the deep wounds left by conflict. Even years later, the human spirit yearns for healing from the trauma of violence. This reminds us that 雅伟 is close to those whose hearts are broken by such experiences, offering comfort and binding up their wounds.
reflection.zh: 一位前儿童兵挥之不去的记忆和持续的噩梦，揭示了冲突留下的深刻创伤。即使多年以后，人类心灵仍渴望从暴力创伤中得到医治。这提醒我们，雅伟亲近那些因这些经历而心碎的人，赐予他们安慰并包扎他们的伤口。

verse.textEn: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
verse.textZh: 他医好伤心的人，裹好他们的伤处。

title.en: Hegseth warns of migrant 'invasion' of Europe in D-Day memorial speech
title.zh: 赫格塞斯在诺曼底登陆纪念演讲中警告欧洲面临移民“入侵”

summary.en: A political commentator warned of a migrant "invasion" of Europe during a D-Day memorial speech, following similar comments by a US vice president who linked immigration to a recent murder in the UK.
summary.zh: 一位政治评论员在诺曼底登陆纪念活动演讲中，警告欧洲面临移民“入侵”，此前几天，美国副总统也曾将英国一名青少年的谋杀案归咎于移民。

body.en:
US defense secretary Pete Hegseth urged Europe to counter what he termed an "invasion" of its coastline by migration, as he marked the 82nd anniversary of the World War Two D-Day landings in France.

Hegseth also called on European countries to do more to contribute to their own defence, in a speech at the American military cemetery in Colleville-sur-Mer in Normandy.

However, he conspicuously skipped the main international ceremony later in the afternoon marking the anniversary of the Allied landings, which heralded an end to World War Two.

"Sadly, today different European beaches are stormed by different dangerous ideologies," Hegseth said.

On "beaches in Spain and Italy and Greece and Bulgaria, boats and men arrive," he said.

"When will European capitals do something about that invasion? Or is it too late?"

"May we learn from this past," Hegseth said in reference to the pivotal involvement of US troops in the landings.

"The men buried here fought in a war-fighting alliance where every partner ... brought its full measure of industry, courage and sacrifice," he said in front of the 9,387 white crosses of US soldiers killed in action during the Battle of Normandy.

"Real allies doing real things, taking real losses for a shared cause worth fighting and dying for."

Hegseth did not use the word immigration, but his remarks echoed broader Trump administration criticism of Europe over migration, borders and what US officials have described as censorship of nationalist and far-right voices.

On Saturday, UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer's office condemned Vance for blaming immigration for the killing of Henry Nowak , an 18-year-old British student stabbed to death in Southampton, even though both Nowak and his killer were British.

In December, the Trump administration's national security strategy warned that Europe faced the "prospect of civilisation erasure" and could become "unrecognisable" within 20 years.

title.en: This island's population is the same as Darwin's. It's about to play in the World Cup
title.zh: 这个岛屿的人口与达尔文市相当。它即将参加世界杯

summary.en: Curaçao, an island nation with a population comparable to Darwin, is set to compete in the World Cup, sparking discussions about what this significant sporting achievement could mean for its future.
summary.zh: 库拉索是一个人口与达尔文市相当的岛国，即将参加世界杯，这引发了人们对这项重大体育成就可能对其未来意味着什么的讨论。

body.en:
Watch Dateline's latest episode Tiny Island Miracle to learn more about Curaçao and its World Cup dream. Tune in on Tuesday 9 June at 9.30pm AEST on SBS and SBS On Demand.

Last November, at a football stadium in Kingston, Jamaica, a raucous and expectant crowd, mostly dressed in the national team's distinctive yellow, urged on their side to secure a spot in the FIFA World Cup .

In a corner of the stadium, a much smaller group of fans, dressed largely in blue, tried to make their presence felt. They had flown in from the tiny Caribbean island of Curaçao, just off the coast of Venezuela, harbouring the same dream for their team — known as the 'Blue Wave'.

On paper, it was a mismatch. Jamaica, a country with a population of just under three million, versus Curaçao, one of roughly 150,000 (around the size of Darwin or Cairns).

But for the Curaçao fans, the trip was worth it. In a nail-biting match, Curaçao secured a 0-0 draw to top their qualifying group. In doing so, they became the smallest nation by size and population to ever qualify for the World Cup.

Until now, those who have heard of Curaçao might know it because of the drink Blue Curaçao or its beautiful beaches (one of which is famous for its small pigs).

Now people have another reason to recognise the name, as 'Blue Wave' midfielder Juninho Bacuna told SBS Dateline.

"Since we qualified for the World Cup, you see some people thinking, like, 'Who is Curaçao?', and then they're going to look it up and see, like, 'Oh, okay. Curaçao is quite nice'."

"It's an amazing feeling. I think for all of us, everyone's been proud," he said.

"The World Cup, I don't think the island has stopped talking about the World Cup."

Curaçao is one of four countries that make up the Kingdom of the Netherlands. The other islands are Aruba and Sint Maarten, also in the Caribbean.

It's also the poorest island in the kingdom — around 30 per cent of its inhabitants live below the poverty line.

Their parents moved for better opportunities, reflecting a 'brain drain' that has been a constant theme in Curaçao's modern history, with most students completing their university education in the Netherlands or the US. It can raise questions about what it means to be Curaçaoan.

Bacuna's older brother Leandro is the team captain. He is from the Dutch city of Groningen but says his identity has never been in doubt.

reflection.en: The remarkable journey of Curaçao to the World Cup reminds us of the spirit of striving for a goal, no matter the odds. Just as athletes run to win a prize, communities can find purpose and hope in pursuing collective aspirations. This achievement highlights how dedication and teamwork can lead to extraordinary outcomes, inspiring a nation.

title.en: Hunger in Oleshky: Ukraine asks for evacuation
title.zh: 奥列什基的饥饿：乌克兰请求撤离

summary.en: The Ukrainian city of Oleshky has been under Russian occupation since 2022, leaving many residents isolated and facing severe living conditions. Kyiv has now expressed its intention to evacuate these citizens.
summary.zh: 乌克兰城市奥列什基自2022年以来一直被俄罗斯军队占领。许多居民与外界隔绝，生活条件恶劣。现在，基辅希望营救他们。

body.en:
The Ukrainian city of Oleshky has been occupied by Russian troops since 2022. Many residents are cut off from the outside world and living in dire conditions. Now, Kyiv wants to rescue them.

The situation is critical in Oleshky, a city in southern  Ukraine.  When the nearby Kakhovka dam was  destroyed in 2023 , Oleshky was first flooded and then bombed. Today, it is practically cut off from the outside world. But up to 2,000 people still live there, according to the Oleshky Military Administration, They are mostly pensioners and persons with limited mobility — but there are also almost 50 children reportedly.

Prior to Russia 's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022, Oleshky had 24,000 residents and was situated in a popular vacation area. Of the 13 localities in the district, five have been completely destroyed according to officials. But people continue to live in the surrounding area.

It has become almost impossible to leave Oleshky. The city itself and all access roads have been mined by the Russian army. Previously, the Antonivka Road Bridge over the Dnipro River connected Oleshky with the regional capital Kherson, which remains controlled by Ukraine. But the bridge no longer exists. It was blown up by the Russians in November 2022, after they retreated from the right bank of the river and deployed to the left bank.

"In Oleshky, people are dying because of landmines, direct strikes on their homes or shrapnel," Ksenia Archipova, a former resident of Oleshky, who is currently helping people to evacuate on a regular basis, told DW. "The hospital is powered by generators, but there's practically no fuel. Complex operations, such as amputations after mine explosions, are impossible," she said.

This was also confirmed by Natalia, who lived under Russian occupation for almost 18 months before leaving after the demolition of the Kakhovka dam. "People can barely survive, they don't have access to electricity or water. There are virtually no medicine supplies, there is a shortage of groceries, and if there is anything, everyone stands in long queues to buy something, though they have very little money. Roadsides are littered with landmines that can explode when cyclists or pedestrians pass by. This is how many people are dying," Natalia told DW.

She said that she still has relatives and acquaintances in the city with whom she stays in touch — due to its proximity to Kherson, Oleshky is within range of Ukraine's mobile phone network. She said that it was very dangerous for people in Oleshky to talk with her and others in non-occupied Ukraine, as Ukrainian SIM cards are banned in the Russian-occupied territories and all contact with Ukrainians....
body.zh: 乌克兰城市奥列什基自2022年以来一直被俄罗斯军队占领。许多居民与外界隔绝，生活条件极其恶劣。现在，基辅想要营救他们。 乌克兰南部城市奥列什基的局势十分严峻。 2023 年，附近的卡霍夫卡大坝被摧毁时，奥列什基先是被洪水淹没，然后又遭到轰炸。如今，它实际上与外界隔绝了。但据奥列什基军事管理局称，仍有多达 2,000 人住在那里，他们大多是养老金领取者和行动不便的人，但据报道还有近 50 名儿童。 在俄罗斯于 2022 年全面入侵乌克兰之前，奥列什基拥有 24,000 名居民，位于热门度假区。据官员称，该地区 13 个地点中，有 5 个已被完全摧毁。但人们继续居住在周边地区。 离开奥列什基几乎是不可能的。这座城市本身和所有道路都被俄罗斯军队埋设了地雷。此前，第聂伯河上的安东尼夫卡路桥将奥列什基与仍由乌克兰控制的地区首府赫尔松连接起来。但这座桥已不复存在。 2022 年 11 月，俄罗斯人从河右岸撤退并部署到左岸后，炸毁了它。 “在奥列什基，人们因地雷、直接袭击他们的房屋或弹片而死亡，”奥列什基前居民克塞尼亚·阿奇波娃（Ksenia Archipova）告诉德国之声，她目前正在定期帮助人们撤离。 “医院靠发电机供电，但几乎没有燃料。地雷爆炸后截肢等复杂手术是不可能的，”她说。 纳塔利娅也证实了这一点，她在俄罗斯占领下生活了近 18 个月，在卡霍夫卡大坝拆除后离开。 “人们几乎无法生存，没有电力和水。几乎没有药品供应，食品杂货也短缺，即使有什么东西，每个人都排长队购买东西，尽管他们的钱很少。路边布满了地雷，当骑自行车的人或行人经过时，这些地雷可能会爆炸。这就是很多人的死亡，”娜塔莉亚告诉德国之声。 她说，她在这座城市仍有亲戚和熟人保持联系——由于奥列什基靠近赫尔松，因此在乌克兰移动电话网络的覆盖范围内。她说，奥列什基的人们与她和其他未占领的乌克兰人交谈非常危险，因为乌克兰 SIM 卡在俄罗斯占领区被禁止，并且与乌克兰人的所有联系都被禁止......

reflection.en: The plight of Oleshky's residents, cut off and facing hunger, reminds us of the biblical call to practical compassion. Isaiah 58:7 urges us to share food with the hungry and provide shelter for the displaced, recognizing our shared humanity. In times of crisis, responding to such urgent needs becomes a profound act of faith and love.
reflection.zh: 奥列什基居民被隔绝并面临饥饿的困境，提醒我们圣经中对实际怜悯的呼召。以赛亚书58:7敦促我们与饥饿的人分享食物，为流离失所者提供住所，认识到我们共同的人性。在危机时刻，回应这些紧急需求成为一种深刻的信仰和爱之行动。

verse.textEn: Is it not to share your food with the hungry and to provide the poor wanderer with shelter — when you see the naked, to clothe them?
verse.textZh: 不是要把你的饼分给饥饿的人，将飘流的穷人接到你家中，见赤身的给他衣服遮体？

title.en: Fujimori or Sanchez? Peru vote marks 10 years of turmoil
title.zh: 秘鲁选举标志着十年动荡

summary.en: Sunday's presidential runoff in Peru pits Keiko Fujimori against Roberto Sanchez in an election marked by social tension, rising crime and declining confidence in political institutions.
summary.zh: 秘鲁周日的总统决选在藤森惠子和罗伯托·桑切斯之间展开，此次选举的特点是社会紧张、犯罪率上升以及民众对政治机构的信心下降。

body.en:
Sunday's presidential runoff in Peru pits Keiko Fujimori against Roberto Sanchez in an election marked by social tension, rising crime and declining confidence in political institutions.

Nine presidents in 10 years — the figure speaks volumes about the current state of Peruvian politics.

On Sunday, voters will return to the polls. This time, they will choose between Keiko Fujimori , leader of the conservative Popular Force party, and Roberto Sanchez, the candidate for the left-wing Together for Peru. Whoever prevails at the ballot, Peruvians will vote in a climate of deep distrust of institutions, political fragmentation and growing concern over insecurity.

For many observers, the central question is not only who will win the presidency, but whether Peru will be able to break out of the cycle of political crises that has characterized its past decade.

The first round revealed the weakness of Peru's political system. Keiko Fujimori advanced to the runoff with just 17% of the vote, while Roberto Sanchez secured around 12%, highlighting a fragmented political landscape in which 35 presidential candidates competed. The result illustrates the extent to which both finalists lack broad support and enter the second round amid a profound crisis of representation.

For Alonso Cardenas, a political science professor at Antonio Ruiz de Montoya University, the roots of the problem run deeper than a simple electoral contest.

"There is widespread discrediting of the ruling class," Cardenas told DW. According to the political scientist, the widespread public rejection extends to Congress, the presidency and the judiciary. "It is a very serious process of implosion within the system of political representation."

Johanna Pieper, a researcher at the German Institute for Global and Area Studies, agrees that the election reflects a long-running crisis. "People are simply not happy or satisfied. They have no confidence in politics, the government, or Congress," Pieper told DW. She also points to a society divided between Lima and historically marginalized regions, particularly the Andean highlands.

Keiko Fujimori once again places the country's best-known — and most polarizing — political figure at the center of the campaign. She is the daughter of former President Alberto Fujimori , who ruled Peru between 1990 and 2000.

The movement known as Fujimorismo has shaped Peruvian politics for decades. Its supporters point to economic stabilization and the fight against the Maoist guerrilla group Shining Path . Critics, however, highlight deep-seated authoritarian tendencies, corruption scandals and serious human rights violations during her father's time in office.

body.zh: 周日在秘鲁举行的总统决选中，藤森惠子与罗伯托·桑切斯展开了这场选举，这场选举的特点是社会紧张、犯罪率上升和对政治机构的信心下降。 十年内有九位总统——这个数字充分说明了秘鲁政治的现状。 周日，选民将重返投票站。这一次，他们将在保守派人民力量党领袖藤森惠子和左翼秘鲁团结党候选人罗伯托·桑切斯之间做出选择。无论谁在投票中获胜，秘鲁人都将在对机构极度不信任、政治分裂和对不安全问题日益担忧的气氛中投票。 对于许多观察家来说，核心问题不仅在于谁将赢得总统职位，还在于秘鲁是否能够摆脱过去十年的政治危机循环。 第一轮选举暴露了秘鲁政治制度的弱点。藤森惠子 (Keiko Fujimori) 仅以 17% 的得票率晋级决选，而罗伯托·桑切斯 (Roberto Sanchez) 则获得了 12% 左右的选票，凸显了 35 名总统候选人角逐的分散的政治格局。这一结果说明了两位决赛入围者缺乏广泛支持并在深刻的代表性危机中进入第二轮的程度。 对于安东尼奥·鲁伊斯·德蒙托亚大学政治学教授阿隆索·卡德纳斯来说，问题的根源比简单的竞选更为深刻。 卡德纳斯告诉德国之声：“统治阶级的名誉普遍受到损害。”这位政治学家表示，公众的广泛反对延伸到了国会、总统和司法部门。 “这是政治代表制度内一个非常严重的内爆过程。” 德国全球与地区研究所研究员约翰娜·皮珀（Johanna Pieper）也认为这次选举反映了一场长期危机。 “人们根本不高兴或不满意。他们对政治、政府或国会没有信心，”皮珀告诉德国之声。她还指出了利马和历史上边缘化地区（特别是安第斯高地）之间的社会分裂。 藤森庆子再次将日本最著名、也是最两极分化的政治人物置于竞选活动的中心。她是 1990 年至 2000 年间统治秘鲁的前总统阿尔贝托·藤森 (Alberto Fujimori) 的女儿。 几十年来，被称为“藤森主义”的运动塑造了秘鲁的政治。其支持者将矛头指向经济稳定和打击毛派游击队组织“光辉道路”。然而，批评者强调了她父亲任职期间根深蒂固的独裁倾向、腐败丑闻和严重侵犯人权的行为。 政治学家...

reflection.en: A nation grappling with a decade of turmoil, social tension, and declining trust in its institutions highlights the profound impact of governance on societal well-being. This situation reminds us that a nation's health is deeply connected to the moral fabric and integrity of its leadership and systems.
reflection.zh: 一个国家在经历了十年动荡、社会紧张和对机构信任度下降之后，凸显了治理对社会福祉的深远影响。这提醒我们，一个国家的健康状况与其领导层和制度的道德结构和廉正性息息相关。

title.en: As hot summer, blackouts loom, Iraq looks to solar power
title.zh: 炎夏将至，停电阴影笼罩，伊拉克转向太阳能

summary.en: Iraq, a country with abundant sunlight, has only recently begun to seriously consider solar power as a solution to its recurring annual summer electricity crises and blackouts.
summary.zh: 伊拉克拥有充足的阳光，但直到最近才开始认真考虑利用太阳能来解决其每年夏季反复出现的电力危机和停电问题。

body.en:
With so much sunlight, Iraq is very well-positioned to use solar power to help fix its annual summer electricity crisis. So why is it that Iraq's government has only recently started to take solar power seriously?

Iraq has long suffered through scorching summers that the country's national grid hasn't been able to keep up with. But it was only recently that Hiba al-Amiri's family started to seriously consider getting solar panels installed at home to compensate for the annual summer blackouts .

"In the war, Iranian gas was cut and for four days, we had no electricity," the Baghdad-based teacher told DW. Iran supplies up to 40% of the gas that Iraq needs to keep its power stations running, In March, Iran completely cut gas to Iraq after Israel attacked its gas fields .

"We were only using the generator," al-Amiri continued. "After that, a lot of our neighbors were also talking about this [solar]. Everybody is really starting to think about it seriously." 

Installing solar panels in a private household costs somewhere between 5 and 10 million Iraqi dinars (around $3,800-$7,600/€3,200-€6,500), experts told DW. Al-Amiri said she and her brother are now saving money toward that goal, and hope to get a unit by next year.

"The thinking is that we will pay for this project [solar panels] in one year but then after that we won't need to pay for the generator power again," she explained.

Even on its best days, the Iraqi national grid only supplies private households between eight and 12 hours of electricity a day. Ordinary Iraqis compensate for the missing power by paying a subscription to local generator operators. Households in a city like Baghdad might pay between $100 (€86) and $300 a month to keep the lights on.

It's not that Iraqis didn't know about solar power, explained Harry Istepanian, an energy expert and founder of the Washington-based think tank, the Iraq Climate Change Center. "But the generator system was familiar, flexible and required no large upfront investment," he said. "Solar, by contrast, requires capital, reliable equipment, batteries, technical installation and after-sales support."

Additionally, as the International Renewable Energy Agency wrote in a 2025 report , energy tariffs in Iraq are heavily subsidized, which also discourages the private sector from investing in renewables.

But now, generator fees are rising and there's no longer enough state-subsidized diesel for generators. "As a result, solar is gaining appeal. Not because Iraqis have suddenly discovered it but because the cost of relying on the old system has become higher," said Istepanian.

Iraq gets some of the world's highest levels of solar radiation which makes it a perfect candidate for solar energy, Amani Ibraheem...
body.zh: 伊拉克拥有如此充足的阳光，非常适合利用太阳能来帮助解决每年夏季的电力危机。那么，为什么伊拉克政府最近才开始认真对待太阳能呢？ 伊拉克长期以来一直遭受国家电网无法应对的炎热夏季。但直到最近，希巴·阿米里 (Hiba al-Amiri) 的家人才开始认真考虑在家中安装太阳能电池板，以弥补每年夏季停电的影响。 “在战争中，伊朗的天然气被切断，我们有四天没有电，”巴格达的老师告诉德国之声。 伊朗供应了伊拉克发电站运行所需的高达40%的天然气，3月份，在以色列袭击其气田后，伊朗完全切断了对伊拉克的天然气供应。 “我们只使用发电机，”阿米里继续说道。 “在那之后，我们的很多邻居也开始谈论这个[太阳能]。每个人都开始认真思考它。” 专家告诉德国之声，在私人家庭安装太阳能电池板的成本约为 5 至 1000 万伊拉克第纳尔（约 3,800-7,600 美元/3,200-6,500 欧元）。阿米里说，她和她的兄弟现在正在为这个目标存钱，并希望在明年之前得到一套房子。 “我们的想法是，我们将在一年内支付这个项目（太阳能电池板）的费用，但之后我们将不需要再次支付发电机的费用，”她解释道。 即使在最好的日子里，伊拉克国家电网每天也只能为私人家庭提供 8 至 12 小时的电力。 普通伊拉克人通过向当地发电机运营商付费来弥补电力缺失。像巴格达这样的城市，家庭每月可能需要支付 100 美元（86 欧元）到 300 美元才能维持照明。 能源专家、华盛顿智库伊拉克气候变化中心的创始人哈里·伊斯特潘尼安 (Harry Istepanian) 解释说，伊拉克人并不是不了解太阳能。 “但发电机系统很熟悉、灵活，不需要大量的前期投资，”他说。 “相比之下，太阳能需要资金、可靠的设备、电池、技术安装和售后支持。” 此外，正如国际可再生​​能源机构在2025年报告中所写，伊拉克的能源关税得到了大量补贴，这也阻碍了私营部门对可再生能源的投资。 但现在，发电机费不断上涨，国家补贴的柴油不再足够用于发电机。 “因此，太阳能越来越有吸引力。不是因为伊拉克人突然发现了它，而是因为依赖旧系统的成本变得更高，”伊斯特潘尼安说。 阿玛尼·易卜拉欣 (Amani Ibraheem) 表示，伊拉克拥有世界上最高水平的太阳辐射，这使其成为太阳能的完美候选者......

reflection.en: The persistent struggle with electricity shortages in Iraq, despite readily available solar resources, highlights the profound impact of governance on daily life. Leaders are called to act with justice and righteousness, ensuring the well-being of their people by implementing wise and timely solutions.
reflection.zh: 伊拉克尽管拥有丰富的太阳能资源，却长期面临电力短缺的困境，这凸显了治理对民众日常生活产生的深远影响。掌权者蒙召以公义和正直行事，通过实施明智和及时的解决方案来确保人民的福祉。

title.en: How disinformation in Congo is worsening Ebola epidemic
title.zh: 刚果的虚假信息如何加剧埃博拉疫情

summary.en: The deadly Ebola outbreak isn't the only thing causing concern for health workers in Congo. Rumors and disinformation are hindering efforts to contain the virus. The patterns are well-known — and could be confronted.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
The deadly Ebola outbreak isn't the only thing causing concern for health workers in Congo. Rumors and disinformation are hindering efforts to contain the virus. The patterns are well-known — and could be confronted.

Three weeks since the start of the latest  Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of Congo , there have been 397 confirmed cases, including 63 confirmed deaths, according to the latest figures reported by the  African Union's Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention.

And yet: "The community does not believe in this disease. Despite the deaths, people don't believe in it," said John Tumujimbe, head of a team for dignified and safe burials in the small town of Mongbwalu, one of the epicenters of the Ebola epidemic in the Congo's northeastern Ituri province.

"We initially thought of malaria , typhoid or diarrheal diseases," Tumujimbe said. "But, after so many deaths, we sent samples to the INRB."

The INRB — Congo's National Institute for Biomedical Research in the capital, Kinshasa — confirmed that these were indeed cases of Ebola. This led health officials to announce  the 17th Ebola epidemic to be recorded in Congo since the virus was first discovered in 1976.

But health officials say many residents in Mongbwalu rejected this scientific answer.

"When there were the first deaths, there was talk that the coffins were a problem, that it spread from there," said one Mongbwalu resident, who did not want to be named.

Tumujimbe also heard this rumor. "That's how it started: people talked about a coffin that kills people. And then more people died."

Another rumor: Aid workers and paramedics were spreading the virus via the antennas of their vehicles.

At the end of May, an angry crowd gathered at Mongbwalu's general hospital. They demanded that authorities return the bodies of their deceased, eventually setting fire to a tent belonging to the aid organization Doctors Without Borders. The organization had to withdraw its staff.

"There was a panic," hospital director Richard Lokudi told DW. "This allowed several suspected cases to escape. Eighteen patients who were under observation have disappeared."

The health workers worry suspected Ebola patients could have passed the disease on to the people who were sheltering them. There is still no vaccine for the Bundibugyo variant of the Ebola virus now circulating.

Christopher Nehring specializes in researching disinformation, and co-authored a report on the current Ebola epidemic for the Konrad Adenauer Foundation. He said similar rumors pop up in every health emergency.

"They say the disease comes from the lab as a bioweapon; that the vaccination is more harmful than the virus;...
body.zh: 致命的埃博拉疫情并不是引起刚果卫生工作者担忧的唯一事件。谣言和虚假信息正在阻碍遏制病毒的努力。这些模式是众所周知的——并且可以面对。 根据非洲联盟非洲疾病控制和预防中心报告的最新数据，刚果民主共和国最近一次埃博拉疫情爆发三周以来，已有 397 例确诊病例，其中 63 例死亡。 然而：“社区并不相信这种疾病。尽管有人死亡，人们还是不相信这种疾病，”蒙布瓦卢小镇负责尊严和安全埋葬小组的负责人约翰·图穆金贝 (John Tumujimbe) 说，蒙布瓦卢小镇是刚果东北部伊图里省埃博拉疫情的震中之一。 “我们最初想到的是疟疾、伤寒或腹泻病，”图穆金贝说。 “但是，在发生这么多人死亡之后，我们将样本发送给了 INRB。” INRB（位于首都金沙萨的刚果国家生物医学研究所）证实这些确实是埃博拉病例。这导致卫生官员宣布自 1976 年首次发现埃博拉病毒以来，这是刚果记录的第 17 次埃博拉疫情。 但卫生官员表示，蒙布瓦鲁的许多居民拒绝接受这个科学答案。 一位不愿透露姓名的蒙布瓦鲁居民说：“当出现第一批死亡病例时，有人说棺材是个问题，病毒是从那里蔓延开来的。” 图穆金贝也听到了这个传闻。 “事情就是这样开始的：人们谈论棺材会杀人。然后更多的人死了。” 另一个谣言：援助人员和护理人员通过车辆的天线传播病毒。 五月底，愤怒的人群聚集在蒙布瓦鲁综合医院。他们要求当局归还死者的尸体，最终放火烧毁了援助组织无国界医生组织的帐篷。该组织不得不撤回其工作人员。 医院院长理查德·洛库迪（Richard Lokudi）告诉德国之声：“大家都感到恐慌。” “这使得几名疑似病例逃脱。正在接受观察的十八名患者已经失踪。” 卫生工作者担心疑似埃博拉患者可能会将疾病传染给收容他们的人。目前还没有针对目前流行的埃博拉病毒本迪布焦变种的疫苗。 克里斯托弗·内林 (Christopher Nehring) 专门研究虚假信息，并为康拉德·阿登纳基金会 (Konrad Adenauer Foundation) 共同撰写了一份关于当前埃博拉疫情的报告。 他说，每次突发卫生事件都会出现类似的谣言。 “他们说这种疾病作为生物武器来自实验室；疫苗接种比病毒危害更大；……

reflection.en: This story draws attention to truth, discernment, and honest speech. Philippians 4:8 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with discernment and truthful speech, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到真理、分辨与诚实。Philippians 4:8提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以分辨与诚实表达来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

title.en: North Korea says nuclear program 'absolutely nonnegotiable'
title.zh: 朝鲜称核计划“绝对不容谈判”

summary.en: Kim Yo Jong, the sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, has reaffirmed the country's nuclear ambitions ahead of a visit by Chinese President Xi Jinping.
summary.zh: 朝鲜领导人金正恩的妹妹金与正，在中国国家主席习近平访问前重申了该国的核野心。

body.en:
Kim Yo Jong, the sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, has reaffirmed the country's nuclear ambitions ahead of a visit by Chinese President Xi Jinping.

A day before a high-profile visit by Chinese President Xi Jinping, North Korea said it will not back down from developing nuclear weapons.

"Our status as a nuclear power is absolutely nonnegotiable," Kim Yo Jong , the sister of North Korean leader  Kim Jong Un , said in comments published by the official newspaper of record, Rodong Sinmun, on Sunday.

She is considered a key communications and foreign policy figure in North Korea.

"The policy of continuously strengthening self-defensive nuclear war deterrence, as declared by the head of ​state, is an irreversible and final conclusion that must be executed unconditionally," she added.

North Korea announced its first nuclear test in 2006 and enshrined its status as a nuclear power in its constitution in 2023.

Earlier this week, North Korea unveiled a new facility to enrich weapons-grade uranium . Kim visited the site where he called for an "exponential" expansion of the country's nuclear arsenal.

Analysts said the new nuclear site ‌appeared aimed at reinforcing North Korea's negotiating position ahead of the meeting between Kim and Xi.

Kim also visited a major munitions factory and ordered the ⁠country's missile production ​capacity to be more than doubled over the next five years, according to state media.
body.zh: 朝鲜领导人金正恩的妹妹金与正在中国国家主席习近平访问之前重申了该国的核野心。 在中国国家主席习近平高调访问的前一天，朝鲜表示不会放弃发展核武器。 “我们作为核国家的地位是绝对不容谈判的，”朝鲜领导人金正恩的妹妹金与正在官方记录的《劳动新闻》周日发表的评论中表示。 她被认为是朝鲜通讯和外交政策的关键人物。 她补充说：“国家元首宣布的不断加强自卫性核战争威慑政策是不可逆转的最终结论，必须无条件执行。” 朝鲜于2006年宣布进行首次核试验，并于2023年将其核国家地位写入宪法。 本周早些时候，朝鲜公布了一座新的武器级铀浓缩设施。金正恩参观了该地点，并呼吁“指数级”扩大该国的核武库。 分析人士表示，新核设施似乎旨在在金正恩和习近平会晤之前加强朝鲜的谈判地位。 据官方媒体报道，金正恩还参观了一家大型军火工厂，并下令该国的导弹生产能力在未来五年内增加一倍以上。

reflection.en: In a world where nations often seek security through military might, the declaration of an "absolutely nonnegotiable" nuclear program highlights a deep-seated human reliance on power. Yet, the prophetic vision reminds us of a future where instruments of war are transformed into tools for peace, inviting us to imagine a different path for global security.
reflection.zh: 在一个国家常通过军事力量寻求安全的世界里，“绝对不容谈判”的核计划声明凸显了人类对权力的根深蒂固的依赖。然而，先知的异象提醒我们，未来战争的工具将被转化为和平的工具，邀请我们去构想一条不同的全球安全之路。

title.en: China wants to suppress independent cinema. But young film-makers are undaunted by red lines

summary.en: In China, films require official 'dragon seal' approval from state officials for release, yet young filmmakers remain undaunted by these restrictions, continuing to produce independent cinema.
summary.zh: 在中国，电影必须获得共产主义国家官员的“龙印”批准才能发行，但年轻的电影制作人并未被这些限制吓倒，他们继续制作独立电影。

body.en: Unless a film is given ‘dragon seal’ approval from communist state officials, it will never be released in China Class started at 9am. Assignments were doled out, ideas were pitched and scripts written, followed by a long day of shooting and editing. Twelve hours later, 20 aspiring and exhausted film-makers were sat in a crowded, makeshift studio, listening to their work being trashed. “The content is still too poor,” the course director, Nan Xin, remarked, after watching a two-minute film about boys on the loose who harass a stray dog. reflection.en: This story highlights the enduring human spirit that seeks to create and express, even when faced with official suppression. Like the apostles who declared they must obey 雅伟 rather than human authorities, these young filmmakers choose to follow their artistic conscience despite state 'red lines.' Their determination reminds us that true creativity often...
reflection.zh: 这个故事突显了人类不屈不挠的创造和表达精神，即使面对官方压制。正如使徒们宣告他们必须顺从雅伟而不是人一样，这些年轻的电影制作人选择遵循他们的艺术良知，尽管有国家的“红线”。他们的决心提醒我们，真正的创造力往往在强制性批准的限制之外蓬勃发展。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: On China, Trump picked the right battle but the wrong strategy
title.zh: 中国问题：特朗普选对了战场，却用错了策略

summary.en: The article suggests that while the previous administration may have identified a valid challenge regarding China, its trade policy was characterized by disorganized protectionism, arbitrary tariffs, and hostility towards allies, leading to a prolonged and chaotic trade conflict.
summary.zh: 文章指出，尽管前一届政府可能在对华问题上找对了挑战，但其贸易政策的特点是零散的保护主义、混乱的关税以及对盟友的敌意，导致了一场旷日持久且混乱的贸易冲突。

body.en: A long trade war looms. Trump’s scattershot protectionism, chaotic tariffs and belligerence against our natural allies guarantees that US trade policy will remain a hot mess We are in for a long trade war. In the months since “Liberation Day” last year, when Donald Trump let loose a volley of tariffs against imports from everywhere, countries have rushed to build new relationships in the hope of maybe circumventing the US to protect the global trading system. Continue reading...
body.zh: 一场长期的贸易战即将来临。特朗普漫不经心的保护主义、混乱的关税以及对我们天然盟友的好战保证了美国的贸易政策将仍然是一团糟，我们将陷入一场长期的贸易战。自去年“解放日”唐纳德·特朗普对世界各地的进口产品征收一系列关税以来的几个月里，各国纷纷建立新的关系，希望能够绕过美国来保护全球贸易体系。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Navigating complex international relations and trade requires careful thought and a broad base of wisdom. When national policy lacks coherent guidance and alienates allies, the path forward can become chaotic and prolonged. Proverbs reminds us that nations thrive not through isolated action, but through the safety found in a multitude of wise counselors.
reflection.zh: 驾驭复杂的国际关系和贸易需要深思熟虑和广博的智慧。当国家政策缺乏连贯的指导并疏远盟友时，前进的道路可能会变得混乱而漫长。箴言提醒我们，国家兴盛并非靠孤立行动，而是在众多智者的谋划中找到安全。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: Being Towards Death review – Chinese hospital comedy drama uses plucky patients to ask big questions
title.zh: 《向死而生》影评——中国医院喜剧剧情片以坚韧的病人提出重大问题

summary.en: A Chinese hospital comedy-drama explores themes of life and death through a debt-laden caregiver who, after a suicide attempt, finds new meaning from terminally ill patients. A doctor in the film notes, 'Life is a process of constant decay.'
summary.zh: 一部中国医院喜剧剧情片通过一名负债累累的护理人员探讨了生与死的主题，他在一次自杀未遂后，从身患绝症的病人那里找到了生命的全新意义。片中一位医生指出：“生命是一个不断衰败的过程。”

body.en: A debt-laden caregiver attempting suicide is the catalyst for him finding new meaning to life from a ward of terminally ill patients in touching ensemble drama ‘You know the law of entropy? Life is a process of constant decay,” ssays a doctor in this Chinese hospital comedy drama – but not that you’d know it from the gabbling, frenetic first half-hour of director Chen Sicheng’s death-fixated film. Being Towards Death kicks off with caregiver Xiaobing (Jiang Long) about to throw himself off the roof because, after a scheme to flog his superiors care robots fails, he’s in hock to triad loan sharks. Thankfully the film later settles into an intermittently touching ensemble drama with a meta tint; albeit one that doesn’t fully grasp the profundities it’s aiming for. Hauled back from the ledge, Xiaobing is talked by the hospital director into leading a project studying mental health interventions in terminal cancer care. So he finds himself among the “Ward 10 Fearless Squad”, a group of patients whose outlook is as plucky as their diagnoses are grim. Before long, he has co-opted film director Dao (Wang Zichuan) to make a documentary about his roomies, including bullish property mogul Mau (Cai Ming), browbeaten first son Bowen (Huang Yi) and fib-spinning poppet, Xiaobing (Ye Quanxi) – nicknamed Little Bing. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在感人的合奏剧《你知道熵定律吗？这部中国医院喜剧片中的一位医生说：“生命是一个不断腐烂的过程。”但你不会从陈思诚导演这部以死亡为主题的电影的前半小时里喋喋不休、疯狂的内容中了解到这一点。《向死而生》以护理人员小冰（姜龙饰）开始，他打算从屋顶上跳下去，因为在鞭打上级护理机器人的计划失败后，他陷入了黑社会高利贷的困境。值得庆幸的是，这部电影后来这部充满元色彩的时断时续、感人至深的合奏剧虽然没有完全领会其目标，但小冰被医院院长说服去领导一个研究癌症晚期护理心理健康干预的项目，因此他发现自己属于“10号病房无畏小队”，这群患者的前景与他们的诊断一样严峻。道（王紫川饰）要制作一部关于他的室友的纪录片，其中包括看涨的地产大亨毛（蔡明饰）、受威吓的长子鲍文（黄毅饰）和爱撒谎的傀儡小兵（外号小兵）继续阅读...

reflection.en: This story beautifully illustrates how, even as our physical bodies face decay, there can be a profound renewal of spirit and purpose. The caregiver's journey, sparked by the resilience of terminally ill patients, reminds us that inner strength can emerge even when outer circumstances are fading.
reflection.zh: 这个故事优美地阐释了，即使我们的肉体面临衰败，精神和生命目的仍能得到深刻的更新。护理人员的旅程，因身患绝症病人的坚韧而受到启发，提醒我们即使外部环境逐渐消逝，内在的力量依然能够涌现。

verse.textEn: Therefore we do not lose heart. Though outwardly we are wasting away, yet inwardly we are being renewed day by day.
verse.textZh: 所以，我们不丧胆。外体虽然毁坏，内心却一天新似一天。

title.en: ‘Unpredictable and extreme’: Asia braces for El Niño
title.zh: “不可预测且极端”：亚洲为厄尔尼诺现象做准备

summary.en: Weather models project a potentially strong El Niño this year, which could bring extreme weather like heatwaves to India, heavy rainfall to China, and agricultural damage across Southeast Asia. The UN has issued a warning for the world to prepare for its imminent return and the associated global impacts.
summary.zh: 天气模型预测今年可能出现强厄尔尼诺现象，这可能给受热浪袭击的印度带来灾难，使中国遭受暴雨，并损害东南亚的农业。联合国已警告世界必须为厄尔尼诺现象的迫近回归及其带来的全球影响做好准备。

body.en: Weather models project a potentially strong El Niño this year, which could spell disaster for heatwave-hit India, drench China and hurt agriculture across south-east Asia The UN has warned that the world must prepare for the imminent return of El Niño and the raised global temperatures and weather extremes it brings. The powerful natural weather pattern has an 80% chance of forming before September and a 90% chance before November, the World Meteorological Organization (WMO) said on Tuesday. Continue reading...
body.zh: 天气模型预测今年可能出现强烈的厄尔尼诺现象，这可能会给遭受热浪袭击的印度带来灾难，使中国遭受洪水侵袭，并损害整个东南亚的农业。联合国警告说，世界必须为即将到来的厄尔尼诺现象及其带来的全球气温升高和极端天气做好准备。世界气象组织 (WMO) 周二表示，这种强大的自然天气模式有 80% 的可能性在 9 月之前形成，90% 的可能性在 11 月之前形成。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As weather patterns become more extreme, the call to prepare for El Niño reminds us of the wisdom in foresight. Proverbs 27:12 encourages us to see danger and take refuge, acting prudently in the face of potential hardship. This wisdom applies not only to natural phenomena but also to how we steward our resources and communities for the future.
reflection.zh: 随着天气模式变得日益极端，为厄尔尼诺现象做准备的呼吁提醒我们预见性智慧的重要性。箴言27:12鼓励我们看见危险就藏身，在潜在的困境面前审慎行事。这种智慧不仅适用于自然现象，也适用于我们如何为未来管理资源和社区。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: UK car sales hit post-Covid high for May as Chinese EV makers gain ground
title.zh: 英国汽车销量创疫情后五月新高，中国电动汽车制造商崭露头角

summary.en: UK car sales reached their highest May level since before the Covid pandemic, with registrations up 7%. Battery electric vehicles (EVs) showed the fastest growth, and Tesla sales increased by 45%, as motorists sought to reduce fuel costs.
summary.zh: 英国5月份汽车销量达到新冠疫情前以来的最高水平，注册量增长7%。电池电动汽车（EV）增长最快，特斯拉销量跃升45%，因为驾车者希望削减燃油费用。

body.en: Registrations up 7% in the month, with battery EVs recording fastest growth and Tesla jumping 45% as motorists look to cut fuel bills British car sales rose in May to their strongest level for the month since before the Covid pandemic, driven in part by strong growth from the Chinese manufacturers BYD and Chery. Car registrations rose by 7% to 160,662 during the month, according to figures from the Society of Motor Manufacturers and Traders (SMMT), a lobby group. Continue reading...
body.zh: 5 月注册量增长 7%，其中电池电动汽车增长最快，特斯拉跃升 45%，因驾车者希望削减燃油费用英国汽车销量 5 月份升至新冠大流行前以来的最高水平，部分原因是中国制造商比亚迪和奇瑞的强劲增长。根据游说团体汽车制造商和贸易商协会 (SMMT) 的数据，本月汽车注册量增长 7%，达到 160,662 辆。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The surge in car sales, particularly electric vehicles, reflects a desire for economic efficiency and a return to pre-pandemic activity. As we see prosperity and new opportunities emerge, it's a good moment to remember that the ability to gain wealth ultimately comes from 雅伟. This perspective helps us approach economic growth with gratitude and wisdom,...
reflection.zh: 汽车销量，尤其是电动汽车的激增，反映了人们对经济效率的渴望以及疫情前活动的回归。当我们看到繁荣和新机遇出现时，这是一个很好的时机来记住，获得财富的能力最终来自雅伟。这种视角帮助我们以感恩和智慧来对待经济增长，认识到所有祝福的源头。

verse.textEn: Remember Yahweh your God, for it is he who gives you the ability to produce wealth.
verse.textZh: 你要记念雅伟你的神，因为得货财的力量是他给你的。

title.en: Tiananmen dissident lambasts China on massacre anniversary
title.zh: 天安门异议人士在屠杀周年纪念日谴责中国

summary.en: On the anniversary of the Tiananmen Square massacre, Wu'er Kaixi, who played a leading role during the 1989 protests, spoke to DW about his personal loss and nearly four decades in exile.
summary.zh: 在天安门广场屠杀事件周年纪念日之际，1989年抗议活动中的主要人物吾尔开希向德国之声讲述了他的个人损失和近四十年的流亡生涯。

body.en:
On the anniversary of the Tiananmen Square massacre, Wu'er Kaixi, who played a leading role during the 1989 protests, spoke to DW about his personal loss and nearly four decades in exile.

Wu'er Kaixi has put on weight in the last 37 years and his greying hair no longer flops over his eyes in the style he affected as a student at Beijing Normal University in 1989, but some things have not changed.

He is, for instance, still on the list of student dissidents that the Chinese government identified as the ringleaders of the Tiananmen Square protests in those heady days when democracy seemed a possibility for China.

Now, 58 and living in Taipei, Kaixi is just as outspoken about the Chinese government, which has made it plain that he will never be granted amnesty and that he can never return home.

Speaking in Tokyo on Wednesday, a day before the anniversary of the brutal suppression of the demonstrations, Kaixi said, "What I have been trying to tell the world is the simple fact that China is a threat not only to peaceful dissenters in China, but also a direct threat to the entire civilization of mankind."

For too long, countries have looked the other way when Beijing has oppressed internal dissent, including ethnic minorities such as Tibetans and Uyghurs, and hoped to encourage China to become a responsible member of global society through engagement.

Other governments put trade and economic opportunities over human rights, he said, but nations appear to have realized their mistake.

"The US has had a pro-China policy that is appeasement," he said. "The US led and the rest of the world followed."

"China was allowed to join the World Trade Organization and the global trade system because it was hoped that this would lead to a civil society that would eventually give birth to democracy," he said.

That has not happened yet, he said, but at least President Donald Trump is approaching the situation from a different perspective, of a businessman who is willing to apply leverage.

"Japan, the US and every other country seem to have misunderstood China," he told DW. "They think China is led by ideology, by nationalism or communism, but that's wrong. The Chinese Communist Party is a criminal group that is driven by profit."

And while the Chinese leaders "talk about rejuvenation" and how taking control of Taiwan will benefit the nation — and a public fed on propaganda is roused to the party's aims — the reality is quite different, Kaixi said.

"They do not care about rejuvenating China; all they care about is adding another zero to their bank balances,” he said. "They are nothing but common thieves."

And he cautions other governments — including that of Germany — to be wary of investments that look like sound business propositions...
body.zh: 在天安门广场大屠杀周年纪念日，在 1989 年抗议活动中发挥主导作用的吾尔开希向德国之声讲述了他个人的损失和近四十年的流亡经历。 37年来，吾尔开希的体重有所增加，花白的头发不再像1989年在北京师范大学读书时那样垂在眼睛上，但有些事情并没有改变。 例如，在那些令人兴奋的日子里，当中国似乎有可能实现民主时，他仍然在中国政府认定的天安门广场抗议活动的头目学生持不同政见者名单上。 现年 58 岁、居住在台北的开西同样对中国政府直言不讳，中国政府明确表示他永远不会获得特赦，也永远无法回家。 周三，在残酷镇压示威周年纪念日的前一天，凯西在东京发表讲话时说，“我一直试图告诉世界一个简单的事实，即中国不仅对中国的和平异议人士构成威胁，而且对整个人类文明构成直接威胁。” 长期以来，当北京镇压藏族和维吾尔族等少数民族内部异见人士时，各国都视而不见，并希望通过接触鼓励中国成为全球社会负责任的一员。 他说，其他政府将贸易和经济机会置于人权之上，但各国似乎已经意识到自己的错误。 “美国一直奉行绥靖政策，”他说。 “美国领先，世界其他国家紧随其后。” “中国被允许加入世界贸易组织和全球贸易体系，因为人们希望这将带来一个最终诞生民主的公民社会，”他说。 他说，这种情况尚未发生，但至少唐纳德·特朗普总统正在从一个愿意施加影响力的商人的不同角度来处理这一情况。 “日本、美国和其他所有国家似乎都误解了中国，”他告诉德国之声。 “他们认为中国是由意识形态、民族主义或共产主义领导的，但这是错误的。中国共产党是一个受利益驱动的犯罪集团。” 凯西说，虽然中国领导人“谈论复兴”以及控制台湾将如何使国家受益，而且公众在宣传中被唤醒，了解党的目标，但现实却截然不同。 “他们不关心振兴中国；他们关心的只是在银行存款余额上再增加一个零，”他说。 “他们只不过是普通的小偷。” 他警告其他政府——包括德国政府——对那些看似合理的商业主张的投资要保持警惕……

reflection.en: For decades, dissidents like Wu'er Kaixi have carried the weight of speaking truth to power, enduring exile and personal loss for their convictions. Their steadfastness reminds us of the profound moral choice to prioritize conscience and justice, even when it means defying human authority.
reflection.zh: 几十年来，像吾尔开希这样的异议人士肩负着向权力说真话的重担，为他们的信念忍受流亡和个人损失。他们的坚定提醒我们，即使这意味着反抗人类权威，也要优先考虑良知和正义，这是一个深刻的道德选择。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Hong Kong artist who tried to mark Tiananmen massacre intercepted by police

summary.en: A performance artist in Hong Kong was quickly intercepted by plainclothes police while attempting to commemorate the victims of the 1989 Tiananmen Square crackdown with red thread. This incident highlights the increasing sensitivity surrounding public acts of remembrance for the killings in Hong Kong.
summary.zh: 一名香港行为艺术家试图用红线纪念1989年天安门广场镇压的受害者时，被便衣警察迅速拦截。这起事件凸显了香港对公开纪念六四事件的敏感度日益增加。

body.en: Public acts to commemorate the 1989 killings have become increasingly sensitive in Hong Kong A performance artist in Hong Kong who tried on Wednesday to honour the victims of Beijing’s 1989 Tiananmen Square crackdown was quickly stopped by plainclothes police, the latest sign of the city’s shrinking freedom of expression. Sanmu Chen tried to tie a symbolic red thread to a street signpost in Causeway Bay, a shopping district close to a park that previously hosted an annual candlelight vigil on 4 June to commemorate those who died in the 1989 student-led protests. Continue reading...
body.zh: 纪念 1989 年杀戮的公共活动在香港变得越来越敏感 周三，一名香港行为艺术家试图纪念北京 1989 年天安门广场镇压的受害者，但很快就被便衣警察制止，这是香港言论自由萎缩的最新迹象。陈三木试图在铜锣湾的一个街道路标上系上一条具有象征意义的红线。铜锣湾是一个靠近公园的购物区，几十年来，铜锣湾每年都会在 6 月 4 日举办烛光守夜活动，以纪念在 1989 年学生领导的抗议活动中丧生的人们。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In Hong Kong, an artist's quiet act of remembrance for historical events was swiftly halted by authorities. This echoes the enduring tension between human laws and the call of conscience to honor truth and memory. When faced with conflicting demands, the biblical principle reminds us to obey God rather than human beings, upholding what is right in His sight.
reflection.zh: 在香港，一名艺术家为纪念历史事件而进行的安静行为迅速被当局阻止。这反映了人类法律与良心呼唤之间，在尊重真相和记忆方面的持久张力。当面对相互冲突的要求时，圣经原则提醒我们，顺从雅伟胜于顺从人，坚持在祂眼中看为正确的事。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: ‘Every year I get new pictures’: the fight to preserve the memory of Tiananmen
title.zh: “每年我都会得到新照片”：为保存天安门记忆而战

summary.en: Amid increasing censorship in China under Xi Jinping's rule, international efforts are growing to document and preserve the memory of the Tiananmen Square massacre of June 4, 1989, which involved a bloody crackdown on peaceful protesters.
summary.zh: 在习近平统治下中国国内审查日益严格之际，海外正在加紧努力记录和保存1989年6月4日天安门广场大屠杀的记忆，那次事件是对和平抗议者的血腥镇压。

body.en: Amid growing censorship at home under the rule of Xi Jinping, efforts to document the massacre of 4 June, 1989, are intensifying abroad Discussions about the bloody crackdown on peaceful protesters that took place around Beijing’s Tiananmen Square on 4 June, 1989 – and in cities across China – often dwell on the risk of forgetting the massacre. The passage of time, with the world’s eyes soon drawn elsewhere, and suppression by authorities at home mean that the pivotal moment in Chinese history is at risk of fading into grey. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在习近平统治下，国内审查制度不断加强，而在国外，记录 1989 年 6 月 4 日大屠杀的努力正在加紧进行。有关 1989 年 6 月 4 日北京天安门广场周围以及中国各地城市对和平抗议者进行血腥镇压的讨论常常集中在忘记大屠杀的风险上。随着时间的流逝，世界的目光很快被转移到别处，加上国内当局的打压，意味着中国历史上的关键时刻面临着灰暗的风险。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the face of attempts to erase historical events, the human spirit often strives to remember and ensure that truth is not forgotten. This ongoing effort to document the Tiananmen Square massacre reflects a deep conviction that the past must be acknowledged for future generations.
reflection.zh: 面对抹去历史事件的企图，人类精神常常努力铭记并确保真相不被遗忘。这种持续记录天安门大屠杀的努力，反映了一种深刻的信念，即必须让后代了解过去。

verse.textEn: We will not hide them from their descendants; we will tell the next generation the praiseworthy deeds of Yahweh, his power, and the wonders he has done.
verse.textZh: 我们不将这些事向他们的子孙隐瞒，要将雅伟的美德和他的能力，并他奇妙的作为，述说给后代听。

title.en: How China keeps North Korea's economy alive
title.zh: 中国如何维持朝鲜经济运转

summary.en: Pyongyang relies on China for 95% of its legitimate trade; hacking, arms deals and remittances also help it stay afloat.
summary.zh: 平壤95%的合法贸易依赖中国，此外，黑客攻击、军火交易和侨汇也帮助其维持经济运转。

body.en:
Xi Jinping is about to visit North Korea for the first time since 2019. Pyongyang relies on China for 95% of its legitimate trade; hacking, arms deals and remittances also help it stay afloat.

North Korea runs one of the most bizarre economies on the planet. Despite being one of only a handful of nations with nuclear weapons , its 2024 gross domestic product (GDP) was a paltry $26.6 billion (€22.9 billion).

This is about 70 times smaller than South Korea's $1.86 trillion economy and about a fifth of the annual revenue of the world's top-traded company, Nvidia.

Thanks to a centrally planned economy that prioritizes domestic production, North Korea is nowhere near as reliant on trade as your average free-market economy, partly due to international sanctions, introduced by the United Nations in 2017 over its nuclear weapons and ballistic missiles program.

The North's total imports and exports account for just a small fraction of GDP, versus the South, where international trade makes up around 80% of the economy, according to the World Bank.

You could say that China plays almost an exclusive role in North Korea's minimal reliance on trade .

According to the Washington-based think tank the National Committee on North Korea , Pyongyang depends on China for up to 95% of total trade and 85% of its exports.

Almost all imports also come from China. In 2024, North Korea's legitimate imports totaled just $2.33 billion — tiny by global standards.

With no domestic oil production, these deliveries from China include petroleum and other fuels and are essential in keeping the economy functioning, along with food, textiles, machinery, electronics and vehicles.

This gives Beijing enormous economic clout over North Korean leader Kim Jong Un . A recent report suggested that US President Donald Trump is now trying to leverage that muscle to bring Pyongyang back to the negotiating table over its contentious nuclear weapons program.

Chinese President Xi Jinping is scheduled to visit Pyongyang on June 8 and 9, according to state media in both countries. It will be Xi's first visit to North Korea since 2019. 

Legitimate exports from what the US labels a rogue state are even less impressive. According to the Korea Trade-Investment Promotion Agency, North Korea's exports barely reached $360 million in 2024.

Those foreign sales are strikingly modest, with fake hair and wigs the country's only best seller, making up about 40% of exports, primarily to China, which then reexports them to the rest of the world.

North Korea turned to wigs for vital foreign income after sanctions blocked its traditional big exports like coal and minerals, while fake hair was not explicitly...
body.zh: 平壤95%的合法贸易依赖中国；黑客攻击、军火交易和汇款也有助于其维持生计。 朝鲜是地球上最奇怪的经济体之一。尽管是少数几个拥有核武器的国家之一，但其 2024 年国内生产总值 (GDP) 仅为 266 亿美元（229 亿欧元）。 这大约比韩国 1.86 万亿美元的经济规模小 70 倍，大约是全球交易量最大的公司 Nvidia 年收入的五分之一。 由于实行优先考虑国内生产的中央计划经济，朝鲜对贸易的依赖程度远不及普通自由市场经济，部分原因是联合国于 2017 年对其核武器和弹道导弹计划实施了国际制裁。 根据世界银行的数据，北方的进出口总额仅占 GDP 的一小部分，而南方的国际贸易约占经济的 80%。 你可以说，在朝鲜对贸易的最低程度依赖中，中国几乎扮演​​着唯一的角色。 总部位于华盛顿的智库朝鲜问题国家委员会表示，平壤高达 95% 的贸易总额和 85% 的出口依赖中国。 几乎所有进口也来自中国。 2024 年，朝鲜的合法进口总额仅为 23.3 亿美元——按照全球标准来看，这个数字很小。 由于国内不生产石油，来自中国的这些运输包括石油和其他燃料，以及食品、纺织品、机械、电子和车辆，对于保持经济运转至关重要。 这使北京对朝鲜领导人金正恩拥有巨大的经济影响力。最近的一份报告表明，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普现在正试图利用这一力量，让平壤就其有争议的核武器计划重返谈判桌。 韩国联合通讯社最近报道称，中国国家主席习近平预计将在未来几周内访问平壤，发挥关键的调解人作用，帮助弥合特朗普和金正恩之间长期争端的分歧。北京尚未确认此次行程。 被美国称为流氓国家的合法出口更是不那么令人印象深刻。根据韩国贸易投资振兴院的数据，2024 年朝鲜的出口额勉强达到 3.6 亿美元。 这些国外销售量极其有限，其中假发和假发是该国唯一最畅销的商品，约占出口额的 40%，主要销往中国，然后中国将其再出口到世界其他地区。 在制裁阻碍煤炭和矿产等传统大宗出口后，朝鲜转向假发来获取重要的外国收入，而……

reflection.en: This news highlights how external support can sustain regimes, with significant implications for the lives of ordinary people. Proverbs 29:2 reminds us that when wicked rulers are in power, the people groan under the burden. The story prompts reflection on the broader impact of international economic ties and the moral weight of such connections.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻揭示了外部支持如何维持政权，这对普通民众的生活有着深远影响。箴言29:2提醒我们，恶人掌权时，百姓就会叹息。这个故事促使我们反思国际经济联系的深远影响及其道德分量。

verse.textEn: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; when the wicked rule, the people groan.
verse.textZh: 义人增多，民就喜乐；恶人掌权，民就叹息。

title.zh: 澳洲栏目

title.en: 'See what happens': PM takes aim at Coalition over 'divisive' permanent resident debate
title.zh: 总理就“分裂性”永久居民辩论抨击联盟党

summary.en: Both One Nation and the Coalition have proposed policies affecting permanent residents, including on housing and social services.
summary.zh: 一国党和联盟党都提出了影响永久居民的政策，包括住房和社会服务方面。

body.en:
Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has challenged the Opposition and One Nation's policies affecting permanent residents , arguing the group is a vital part of the Australian workforce as he criticised the Coalition's rhetoric as increasingly indistinguishable from that of its right-wing rival.

Speaking to reporters on Sunday, Albanese criticised suggestions that permanent residents should face restrictions on housing or government services, saying many had lived in Australia for decades and play essential roles in Australian society.

"Now we have a different coalition of people, the Liberal One Nationals, where it is increasingly difficult to see a difference between what the Liberal or National parties are saying and what the One Nation party is saying," Albanese said from the Sunshine Coast on Sunday.

He referenced a fumble this week by One Nation MP Barnaby Joyce, who suggested permanent residents would have to become Australian citizens or be forced to sell their homes under his party's housing policy.
